title: When discipline has to become deeper than mood
issueStatement: Good intentions keep arriving sincerely, but they are still too dependent on energy, novelty, or emotion to survive an ordinary week.
centralInsight: Gurbani locates discipline inside remembrance, restraint, and inner honesty. It is less about intensity and more about truthful repetition.
practicalReflection: The point is not to appear serious. The point is to become dependable in the places where the soul keeps leaking away.
actionPrompt: Reduce the next faithful act until you know you can keep it without performance or self-deception.

daily.label: Daily
daily.title: Discipline in the ordinary rhythm
daily.issueStatement: Discipline often fails in the middle stretch of the day, when sincerity is still present but the structure around it has gone slack.
daily.centralInsight: The Guru teaches steadiness that can survive the ordinary rhythm, not only the dramatic beginning of a new resolve.
daily.practicalReflection: Routine is where discipline is either embodied or exposed. If the pattern cannot live there, it is not ready yet.
daily.actionPrompt: Identify the smallest part of your daily rhythm where remembrance can reliably fit, and guard that place for the next seven days.

pressure.title: Discipline when life gets compressed
pressure.issueStatement: Pressure tempts you to abandon the very practices that would keep the mind from becoming ruled by pressure.
pressure.centralInsight: Under strain, discipline becomes simplification. The Guru does not ask for theatrical effort, but for faithful continuity.
pressure.practicalReflection: When the day compresses, the spiritual task is to keep one true thread alive instead of scattering into all-or-nothing thinking.

practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: Building discipline that lasts
practice.issueStatement: The deeper problem is not lack of inspiration; it is lack of a form that can outlast inspiration.
practice.centralInsight: Discipline matures when repetition becomes truthful enough to survive boredom, success, and invisibility.
practice.practicalReflection: A durable practice is not glamorous. It is shaped to remain intact when no emotional reward arrives immediately.
practice.actionPrompt: Choose one practice to simplify, schedule, and repeat until it feels ordinary rather than impressive.
